bio: As Academic Coordinator, I help Cabot students with academic questions and issues, manage student records, and help with House events and Commencement. I bring a wealth of experience in higher education administration at Harvard, including working in accessibility services at DCE. I had a prior career in the music industry, before transitioning to higher ed. Outside of work, you might find me rowing on or biking around the Charles River. I also volunteer for both the Head of the Charles Regatta and the Boston Marathon. Community Cabot House Role Residential Academic Coordinators
